questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 12 cm and a height of 5 cm. What is its area?

block.label: Quick Recall
block.sub: Four options, one answer — keep it fast

questions.why: Area of a triangle is ½ × base × height, so ½ × 12 × 5 = 30 cm². Don't forget to halve after multiplying.

questions.prompt: A cylinder's total surface area combines the curved surface with which other area?

questions.why: A cylinder has two circular ends plus the curved side, so total surface area needs both circles, not just one.

questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 22 cm and a height of 4 cm. Slow down and work through it step by step: what is its area?

questions.prompt: In Lord of the Flies, what finally happens to Piggy's glasses?

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: In a sealed container, 20g of reactants react fully. What is the mass of the products?
questions.why: Mass is conserved in a closed system, so the products weigh exactly the same as the reactants: 20g.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What do we call it when a reaction produces a colour change?
questions.why: A colour change is another visible sign that a new substance has formed during a chemical reaction.
